crossRefs.note: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed…
“Yahweh’s Spirit spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.
Then on that day David first ordained to give thanks to Yahweh, by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.
Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before Yahweh, our Maker,
Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!
Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.
Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

parallels.note: The man bowed his head, and worshiped Yahweh.

people.name: Asaph
people.line: Levite musician, psalmist, and ancestor of temple singers

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praises to Yahweh with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. They sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshiped.
translations.bsb: Then King Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to sing praises to the LORD in the words of David and of Asaph the seer. So they sang praises with gladness and bowed down and worshiped.
translations.kjv: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.
translations.asv: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praises unto Jehovah with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.
